behavior: Interruption, invalidation, negotiation rejection and timeout schedule one asynchronous retry per connection generation.
Consecutive failures use 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and capped 30 second delays; authentication resets backoff.
Each attempt creates a new mutually code-signature-checked connection, negotiates protocol 1 with a fresh epoch and probes the helper.
Stale replies, duplicate error callbacks and old negotiation timers cannot disrupt a newer authenticated connection.
Helper enrollment remains an explicit launch option. The conventional browser tab strip stays available.

validation.optimized_incremental_build: Passed with four jobs; final build completed 5 steps in 23.92 seconds.
